newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 8.510 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 8.510 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton production from the 1996/97 (July/June) crop reached 8.51 million 375-lb bales by March 1, from 9.71 million bales in the same year-ago period, the local ginners' organisation said on Tuesday.
The Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association said exporters had bought 8,800 bales compared to 1.246 million last year, and spinning mills 6.888 million bales against 7.287 million last year.

Some 1.461 million bales were lying unsold with ginning factories while 152,220 un-ginned press bales were also in stock with them, compared to a total stock of 1.176 million bales in the same period last year, it said.
